newsitem.title: USA: Soros group lifts stake in Rowan Cos.
newsitem.headline: Soros group lifts stake in Rowan Cos.

text.p: A group led by international financier George Soros said Thursday it raised its stake in Rowan Cos Inc to 7,796,000 common shares or 9.11 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 1,423,700 additional common shares bought between November 4 and December 13 at prices ranging from $20.841 to $22.050 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes. The size of the stake is based on 85,539,572 outstanding common shares.

Within the group, George Soros holds a 7.93 percent stake in the company or 6,784,000 common shares, and Stanley Druckenmiller, a managing director of Soros Fund Management, holds a 1.18 percent stake or 1,012,000 common shares.
The Houston, Texas-based company is a major provider of international offshore contract drilling and helicopter services. It also operates a mini-steel mill.
